integrity: Proof and two independently implemented finite checks are supplied. The finite checks corroborate local lemmas and exact rational analogues, not the full irrational statement. Originality is assessed against accessible primary sources; independent scientific audit and definitive priority adjudication have not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Only binary Sturmian factor languages of irrational slope and positive factor lengths/iteration counts are covered. No classification of individual image fibers, non-Sturmian sources, hare equivalence, or nonbinary alphabets. All-parameter assertion follows from analytic proof; finite experiments are non-exhaustive.
title: Exact iterated tortoise complexity of every Sturmian language
